summary_rationale: Kody Technolab demonstrates genuine commercial traction in its transition from boutique IT services to Physical AI and robotics, evidenced by 200+ live deployed robots (Odigo, Athena, Dasher), UAE retail/pDOOH partnerships (LuLu Group, Hypermedia via Falcon Tech Robotics), a 3-year exclusive Medigo manufacturing mandate, and +97% YoY consolidated revenue growth in H1 FY27 (Rs 62 Cr; TTM Rs 111 Cr). However, the business is rated CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL with KPI health PASS_WITH_WATCH because the RaaS/pDOOH and EMS pivot has sharply degraded near-term cash and margin quality: consolidated OPM compressed from 35% (FY25) to 30% (FY26) and 19% (Sep 2026), Debtor Days reached 192 days and Working Capital Days tripled to 197 days, FY26 Free Cash Flow was -Rs 53 Cr (funded by +Rs 113 Cr preferential equity/warrants and a jump in borrowings from Rs 8 Cr to Rs 27 Cr in Sep 2026), Other Income accounts for Rs 9.21 Cr (~32% of TTM PBT), H1 FY27 effective tax spiked to 47%, statutory reporting lacks a software-vs-robotics segment split, and promoter holding declined from 73.01% to 68.82% by Oct 2026.
